description: Anonymized LinkedIn Job Alert digests for tools/gmail_job_alerts.py. Every company, address and job id is invented; the shapes (header set, card layout, chrome links, tracking parameters) are the ones the real digest uses. Bodies stay plain text so this file can be reviewed like the mail it stands in for - the tool expands them into Gmail API shape at load time.
